## Output scheduling, statistics and termination (`outputs: dt`) {#sec-ch14-schedule}

Local symbols (flagged to the editor): $q_i$ the value of a field after accepted step $i$; $w_i$ that step's length;
$W$ the summed weight since the last write; $\bar q$, $M_2$ the running weighted mean and sum of squared deviations.

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What**: each output fires when the time reaches its next time, which then advances by one interval; selected
`*_stat` variables write time-weighted means and standard deviations since the previous write. A run ends on its
time or cycle limit or on a signal, with one final write. **Switch**: output `dt`; `variables` (statistics
selections); `integration: tlim`, `nlim`. **Default**: `dt: 0` (every cycle). **Requires**: nothing. **Order**: n/a;
the statistics are exact for the sampled states. **Defining equation**: @eq-ch14-schedule-moments.
:::

The driver calls `make_outputs` once after initialisation and once after every accepted step. A rejected (redone)
step writes nothing.

### Derivation

Between two writes the statistics weight each accepted state by the step that produced it, $w_i = t_i - t_{i-1}$.
They are updated in place by the weighted form of Welford's recurrence. With $W_{i-1} = \sum_{j<i} w_j$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\bar q_i &= \bar q_{i-1} + \frac{w_i}{W_{i-1} + w_i}\,(q_i - \bar q_{i-1}), \\
M_{2,i} &= M_{2,i-1} + w_i\,(q_i - \bar q_{i-1})(q_i - \bar q_i), \\
\sigma &= \sqrt{\max(M_2 / W,\ 0)} ,
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch14-schedule-moments}

By induction, $\bar q_i = \sum_{j \le i} w_j q_j / W_i$ and $M_{2,i} = \sum_{j \le i} w_j (q_j - \bar q_i)^2$, the
weighted mean and the weighted sum of squared deviations; $M_2/W$ is the population variance, with no small-sample
correction. Each state is weighted by the step that ends at it (a right-endpoint rule in time). @eq-ch14-schedule-moments
is `update_weighted_moments` and `PrimStatStd` ([`output_type.cpp:282-360`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/output/output_type.cpp#L282-L360)).

### Numerical method

**Schedule.** For each output, `make_outputs` first accumulates the statistics. On the final call it writes
unconditionally. Otherwise, when $t \ge t_\text{next}$, it writes, resets the statistics to the current time,
advances $t_\text{next}$ by $\Delta t_o$ once, and increments the file number
(`MeshBlockImpl::make_outputs`, [`meshblock.cpp:985-1002`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L985-L1002)). With $\Delta t_o = 0$, $t_\text{next}$ never moves
and the output fires every cycle. $t_\text{next}$ advances by one interval per write even when a step jumps past
several, so an output whose interval is shorter than the step falls behind the run time: it fires on every step
until it catches up.

**Final write.** NetCDF and PnetCDF outputs skip the final call; the restart output writes `final`
(@sec-ch14-restart).

**Statistics.** `AccumulateStats` starts the clock at its first call. From then on it
applies @eq-ch14-schedule-moments to `hydro_w` (and `scalar_r`) with the time since its previous call as the weight. Calls with
zero elapsed time are skipped. `ResetStats` zeroes the sums at each write ([`output_type.cpp:297-345`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/output/output_type.cpp#L297-L345)).
Before the first accumulated interval the mean is the current state and the deviation zero.

**Termination.** The driver loop runs while pyharp's integrator does not stop. It stops when $n_\text{lim} \ge 0$
and the cycle count reaches it, or when $t_\text{lim} \ge 0$ and the time reaches it; a redo result of $-1$ breaks
the loop (`stop`, [`straka.cpp:141-165`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/examples/straka.cpp#L141-L165)). The handler catches SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGALRM
(the wall-time alarm; `SIGALRM` in [`signal_handler.cpp:40-45`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/utils/signal_handler.cpp#L40-L45)). The flags are reduced in
`check_redo` (@sec-ch14-collectives). `finalize` makes the final write and prints the reason: signal, cycle limit,
time limit, or "abnormally". It returns 1 only in the last case (`MeshBlockImpl::finalize`, [`meshblock.cpp:1121-1180`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1121-L1180)).

signalled run. Pass status at the pin was not run for this chapter.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
- Signals are handled only at `check_redo`; a rank that never gets there hangs the others
  (@sec-ch14-collectives).
- An output interval shorter than the step makes the output fire every step until $t_\text{next}$ catches up; it
  does not skip ahead.
- The statistics sample accepted states only, weighted by the step that ends at them; they are not time averages of
  the sub-step stages.
:::
